analysis.study_scope: Analysis of retopology workflow, modifier setup, auto-merge, topology layout around landmarks, slide relax sculpting, and mesh finalization from 07:30 to 14:14.

episodes.problem: Snapping alone does not project new loop cuts automatically.
episodes.observed_fact: Disabling Shrinkwrap reveals mesh floating off target surface.
episodes.instructor_claim: Shrinkwrap modifier automatically projects newly added loop cuts onto target mesh.
episodes.interpretation: Shrinkwrap projects newly generated geometry where manual snapping fails.
episodes.hypothesis: Face snapping alone requires manual vertex tweaking to snap new elements.
episodes.reference_evidence: Loop cut added at 08:07 automatically sits on high-res surface.
episodes.modeling_decision: Keep live Shrinkwrap active alongside face snapping during retopology.
episodes.visible_action: Toggles Shrinkwrap, adds loop cut, demonstrates vertex snapping behavior.
episodes.spoken_reason: Shrinkwrap projects new loop cuts without needing manual movement.
episodes.topology_surface_effect: New edge loops conform instantly to high-poly contours.
episodes.failure: Relying purely on snapping leaves new loop cuts floating above surface.
episodes.correction: Combine live Shrinkwrap modifier with face snapping.
episodes.alternatives: Manually drag every new loop vertex using G.
episodes.transferable_principle: Use live Shrinkwrap modifier to auto-project new topology loops.

episodes.problem: Vertices drift off target surface over time during editing.
episodes.observed_fact: Instructor duplicates Shrinkwrap modifier and applies top instance.
episodes.instructor_claim: Duplicating and applying Shrinkwrap bakes vertex offsets into base mesh position.
episodes.interpretation: Baking intermediate positions resets base vertices closer to target surface.
episodes.hypothesis: Periodic applying prevents ray projection distortion on distant vertices.
episodes.reference_evidence: Duplicate and Apply executed in modifier stack at 08:36.
episodes.modeling_decision: Duplicate and apply top Shrinkwrap periodically while maintaining active secondary modifier.
episodes.visible_action: Switches to Object Mode, duplicates Shrinkwrap, applies top modifier.
episodes.spoken_reason: Bakes projected position onto base mesh coordinates.
episodes.topology_surface_effect: Base vertices realign permanently with target surface.
episodes.failure: Vertices floating far off target generate projection artifacts.
episodes.correction: Duplicate and apply top Shrinkwrap modifier periodically.
episodes.alternatives: Apply Shrinkwrap only at full completion.
episodes.transferable_principle: Periodically apply Shrinkwrap duplicates to re-anchor base vertex positions.

episodes.problem: Adjacent vertices collapse unexpectedly when moved closely.
episodes.observed_fact: Auto-merge option causes adjacent vertices to weld during transform.
episodes.instructor_claim: Auto-merge speeds quad creation but high threshold distance causes accidental collapse.
episodes.interpretation: Auto-merge speeds workflow but needs strict threshold management.
episodes.hypothesis: Disabling Auto-Merge requires manual vertex merging via hotkeys.
episodes.reference_evidence: Threshold changed from 0.001m to 0.0001m at 09:28, then toggled off at 09:34.
episodes.modeling_decision: Reduce Auto-Merge threshold distance or disable it when working in tight areas.
episodes.visible_action: Opens Tool options, lowers threshold distance slider, toggles Auto Merge checkbox.
episodes.spoken_reason: Lowering threshold or turning off Auto Merge prevents accidental merging.
episodes.topology_surface_effect: Prevents unintended quad collapse in dense vertex regions.
episodes.failure: High auto-merge threshold destroys edge loops by welding neighbor vertices.
episodes.correction: Reduce threshold to 0.0001m or turn off Auto Merge.
episodes.alternatives: Use manual merge hotkeys during modeling.
episodes.transferable_principle: Lower or disable Auto-Merge threshold when retopologizing dense areas.

episodes.problem: Structuring topology across deforming anatomical landmarks.
episodes.observed_fact: Instructor places boundary edge loops around eye sockets, mouth, and horns before filling spans.
episodes.instructor_claim: Define important deformation loops around eyes and mouth before connecting with quads.
episodes.interpretation: Deformation landmarks require continuous edge loops for organic articulation.
episodes.hypothesis: Extruding continuous grids without landmark loops causes pinching during animation.
episodes.reference_evidence: Annotations and edge rings drawn around eye and mouth at 09:50.
episodes.modeling_decision: Construct feature boundary loops first, then bridge intermediate regions with quads.
episodes.visible_action: Extrudes loop strips around eye and mouth openings, fills intermediate spans with F.
episodes.spoken_reason: Defining main loops first ensures deformation areas articulate correctly.
episodes.topology_surface_effect: Creates feature flow rings connected by quad patches.
episodes.failure: Filling mesh without landmark loops leads to poor edge flow across joints.
episodes.correction: Construct feature boundary loops first before bridging open space.
episodes.alternatives: Grid fill whole head uniformly and slice loops later.
episodes.transferable_principle: Prioritize isolated boundary loops around deforming landmarks before filling quad patches.

episodes.problem: Generated mesh patches appear transparent due to inverted normals.
episodes.observed_fact: BSurface creation generates transparent backface-visible patches.
episodes.instructor_claim: Flipped surface normals cause backfaces to render transparent in viewport.
episodes.interpretation: Inconsistent face normals disrupt shading and modifier behavior.
episodes.hypothesis: Recalculating normals aligns face normals along target surface vector.
episodes.reference_evidence: Select linked (L) and Recalculate Normals (Ctrl+Shift+N) executed at 11:33.
episodes.modeling_decision: Select linked inverted patch and recalculate face normals.
episodes.visible_action: Selects linked mesh island with L, presses Ctrl+Shift+N to recalculate normals.
episodes.spoken_reason: Flipping normals aligns surface direction correctly.
episodes.topology_surface_effect: Restores solid viewport shading and consistent orientation.
episodes.failure: Inverted normals break viewport display and modifier projection direction.
episodes.correction: Select linked vertices and recalculate face normals.
episodes.alternatives: Manually select individual faces and run Flip Normals.
episodes.transferable_principle: Audit and recalculate face normal directions during mesh construction.

episodes.problem: Uneven quad spacing across retopologized surface.
episodes.observed_fact: Instructor uses Sculpt Mode Slide Relax tool with Shift smoothing to redistribute vertices.
episodes.instructor_claim: Slide Relax tool moves vertices along surface volume without shrinking model.
episodes.interpretation: Slide Relax homogenizes edge spacing on surface manifold without volume loss.
episodes.hypothesis: Edit Mode vertex smoothing shrinks surface volume inward.
episodes.reference_evidence: Slide Relax brush applied with Shift held down at 12:44.
episodes.modeling_decision: Use Sculpt Mode Slide Relax tool with Shift held down to even out quads.
episodes.visible_action: Switches to Sculpt Mode, selects Slide Relax tool, holds Shift and strokes quads.
episodes.spoken_reason: Slide Relax moves vertices along surface without losing object volume.
episodes.topology_surface_effect: Produces uniform quad distribution without shrinking surface.
episodes.failure: Standard smoothing distorts surface volume or creates quad clustering.
episodes.correction: Use Sculpt Mode Slide Relax tool over retopology mesh.
episodes.alternatives: Use Edit Mode mesh smoothing add-ons.
episodes.transferable_principle: Use Sculpt Mode Slide Relax with Shift smoothing to equalize quad spacing without volume loss.

episodes.problem: Finalizing retopology mesh and auditing symmetry seam.
episodes.observed_fact: Instructor applies Shrinkwrap and Mirror modifiers, checks center seam vertices, and toggles viewport overlays.
episodes.instructor_claim: Apply modifiers and verify center seam vertices are merged to avoid center gaps.
episodes.interpretation: Finalizing asset requires baking modifiers and fixing seam artifacts.
episodes.hypothesis: Unmerged center seam vertices cause open holes during deformation.
episodes.reference_evidence: Mirror applied at 13:08, center seam checked at 13:10, Smooth modifier added at 13:21.
episodes.modeling_decision: Apply modifiers, inspect center seam vertex merging, and disable wireframe viewports.
episodes.visible_action: Applies Shrinkwrap and Mirror, checks seam vertices in Edit Mode, adds Smooth modifier.
episodes.spoken_reason: Ensures no center seam holes exist and previews final retopologized model.
episodes.topology_surface_effect: Yields clean, manifold, symmetric low-poly retopology mesh.
episodes.failure: Unmerged center seam leaves gaps along symmetry line.
episodes.correction: Merge center seam vertices along symmetry axis before final export.
episodes.alternatives: Keep Mirror modifier active until rigging.
episodes.transferable_principle: Verify symmetry seam merging when applying Mirror modifiers during finalization.

limitations: Analysis limited strictly to interval 07:30 to 14:14 (450s to 854s).
